purpose: Two bounded query interventions after a score-blind annotation sufficiency audit. No production adoption or independent release claims.

interventions.name: normalized-observations
interventions.hypothesis: Typed observation codes are readable tokens but the cross-encoder was trained on prose; delimiter normalization can improve procedural ranking without changing observed facts or eligibility.

interventions.name: procedure-question
interventions.factor: Explicit fixed retrieval task added to the unchanged observed query
interventions.hypothesis: The serving query describes symptoms and bookkeeping, but omits the user's direct-procedure task; incident queries rank supporting replay guidance above direct procedures. This tests the new incident/direct-procedure scope, unlike prior intent prefixes added to already explicit human questions. No causal or repair claim is added.

success: Same 80% development macro recall, 90% negative abstention, <=5% false abstention, no direct-precision loss versus unchanged production keyword, reliability/latency gates. Failure means reject; no third intervention or optional pilot.
